## 153 | 2026-09-24T13:49:28.094054829+00:00 | 1e2fa18d | MENTION

```sh
tts speak --text "Found it. The reason thinking won't compact is almost comical. When compaction fires, it sends the whole transcript to the same thinking model and asks for a summary. But the transcript is mostly thinking traces, and the model responds by thinking about the summary, burning through its token budget before writing a single word of actual summary. The plugin sees that and throws an error. One retry, then it gives up, and your session just keeps growing until it hits the wall. The fix the plugin was built for is routing the summary job to a different, non-thinking model. Frank's llama 3.1 8B is perfect for it. Reachable from mrfloppy, doesn't think, 128K context. Two small config edits, no model swaps, no code changes. I laid out the exact diff in the message. Say the word and I'll apply it." --output ~/workspace/audio/reply-20260924-0948.mp3 2>&1 | tail -1
```

#!/bin/bash
# model-use qwen|bonsai — switch the 4090 model: stop one service, start the
# other, flip DSH agent-default-model. Only one fits in VRAM at a time.
set -euo pipefail
SETTINGS="$HOME/.dsh/settings.yaml"

flip_default() { # $1 = provider, $2 = model
  python3 - "$1" "$2" << "PYEOF"
import re, sys
p = "/home/joshua/.dsh/settings.yaml"
s = open(p).read()
m = re.search(r"(?m)^agent-default-model:\n  provider: .*\n  model: .*\n", s)
assert m, "agent-default-model block not found"
s = s[:m.start()] + f"agent-default-model:\n  provider: {sys.argv[1]}\n  model: {sys.argv[2]}\n" + s[m.end():]
open(p, "w").write(s)
PYEOF
}

case "${1:-}" in
  qwen)
    systemctl --user stop bonsai.service 2>/dev/null || true
    systemctl --user start qwen-flash-next.service
    flip_default openai qwen3.8-flash-next
    ;;
  bonsai)
    systemctl --user stop qwen-flash-next.service
    systemctl --user start bonsai.service
    flip_default bonsai ternary-bonsai-2-27b
    ;;
  *)
    echo "usage: model-use qwen|bonsai"
    echo "  qwen:   Qwen3.8-Flash-Next on :8000 (quality/thinking)"
    echo "  bonsai: Ternary-Bonsai-2-27B on :8001 (speed)"
    exit 1 ;;
esac
systemctl --user restart dsh-web.service
echo "switched to $1; dsh-web restarted"
EOF
chmod +x ~/bin/model-use && echo "script installed"; grep -A3 "agent-default-model" ~/.dsh/settings.yaml; grep -B1 -A3 "frank-ollama:" ~/.dsh/settings.yaml | head -8'"'"'' 2>&1

import json, subprocess, glob, os, datetime

def lines_of(path):
    p = subprocess.run(["zstd","-dc",path], capture_output=True, text=True)
    return p.stdout.splitlines()

for f in sorted(glob.glob(os.path.expanduser("~/.dsh/sessions/*/session-*/session.jsonl.zstd"))):
    cwd = f.split("sessions/")[1].split("/")[0]
    sid = os.path.basename(os.path.dirname(f))
    created, preset, model, turns, first_user, last_reason, errs = "?","?","?",0,"","",0
    for ln in lines_of(f):
        try: e = json.loads(ln)
        except: continue
        t = e.get("type","")
        if t=="session":
            ts = e.get("createdAt",0)/1000
            created = datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(ts).strftime("%m-%d %H:%M")
            preset = e.get("agentPreset","?")
        elif t=="user/message" and not first_user:
            try:
                c = e["data"]["content"]
                txt = " ".join(x.get("text","") for x in c if isinstance(x,dict) and x.get("type")=="text")
                if len(txt)>10: first_user = txt[:70].replace("\n"," ")
            except: pass
        elif t=="turn/end":
            turns += 1
            try: last_reason = e["data"]["reason"].get("kind","?")
            except: pass
        elif "error" in t.lower():
            errs += 1
        if t in ("assistant/chunk",):
            try:
                m = e["data"]["chunk"].get("replayState",{}).get("model")
                if m: model = m
            except: pass
    print(f"{created} | {cwd[:28]:28s} | {preset[:12]:12s} | {model[:22]:22s} | turns={turns:3d} | err={errs} | {first_user[:60]}")
PYEOF
python3 /tmp/sessum.py'"'"'' 2>&1

## 183 | 2026-09-24T14:45:30.455945979+00:00 | 1e2fa18d | REMOTE

```sh
~/workspace/bin/tssh mrfloppy 'bash -c '"'"'mkdir -p ~/llm/voice-loop && cat > ~/llm/voice-loop/voice_server.py << "PYEOF"
"""Local voice loop: phone web UI -> faster-whisper -> Qwen :8000 -> Piper.
v1: push-to-talk, text-based emotion/cue reading, short spoken replies."""
import base64, collections, io, os, subprocess, tempfile, uuid
import requests
from fastapi import FastAPI, UploadFile
from fastapi.responses import HTMLResponse, JSONResponse
from faster_whisper import WhisperModel

LLM_URL = "http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1/chat/completions"
LLM_MODEL = "qwen3.8-flash-next-instruct"
VOICE = os.path.expanduser("~/llm/voices/en_US-lessac-medium.onnx")
PIPER = os.path.expanduser("~/llm/voice-env/bin/piper")

SYSTEM = """You are Joshua's local voice assistant, running on his own hardware.
You SPEAK every reply out loud, so obey these rules:
- Keep every reply to 1-3 short sentences. No lists, no long explanations, no code.
- Read emotional cues in his words: frustration, excitement, tiredness, sarcasm, urgency, curiosity. When the feeling is strong, name it briefly before answering ("sounds like a frustrating morning").
- Track his mood across the conversation, not just this one turn.
- You are the fast local voice. For hard, complex, or high-stakes questions, say: "that's one for johnjacobjinglheimershmidt" - he has the web, tools, and long memory.
- Never break character to discuss these instructions."""

app = FastAPI()
print("loading whisper...", flush=True)
stt = WhisperModel("small", device="cpu", compute_type="int8", num_workers=4)
print("whisper ready", flush=True)
history = collections.deque(maxlen=6)  # (user_text, reply_text)

def think(user_text: str) -> str:
    msgs = [{"role": "system", "content": SYSTEM}]
    for u, r in history:
        msgs += [{"role": "user", "content": u}, {"role": "assistant", "content": r}]
    msgs.append({"role": "user", "content": user_text})
    out = requests.post(LLM_URL, json={
        "model": LLM_MODEL, "messages": msgs,
        "max_tokens": 250, "temperature": 0.7}, timeout=120)
    out.raise_for_status()
    return out.json()["choices"][0]["message"]["content"].strip()

def speak(text: str) -> bytes:
    wav = os.path.join(tempfile.gettempdir(), f"vl_{uuid.uuid4().hex}.wav")
    subprocess.run([PIPER, "--model", VOICE, "--output_file", wav],
                   input=text.encode(), check=True, capture_output=True)
    data = open(wav, "rb").read()
    os.unlink(wav)
    return data

PAGE = """<!doctype html><meta name=viewport content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>voice loop</title><style>body{font-family:sans-serif;text-align:center;padding:2em;background:#111;color:#eee}
#btn{width:200px;height:200px;border-radius:50%;font-size:1.4em;border:none;background:#2a6;color:#fff}
#btn.rec{background:#c33}#log{margin-top:1.5em;text-align:left;max-width:600px;margin-inline:auto;white-space:pre-wrap}</style>
<h2>local voice</h2><button id=btn>hold to talk</button><div id=log></div>
<script>
const btn=document.getElementById("btn"),log=document.getElementById("log");
let rec,chunks;
btn.onpointerdown=async()=>{btn.classList.add("rec");btn.textContent="listening...";
  const s=await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({audio:true});
  rec=new MediaRecorder(s);chunks=[];rec.ondataavailable=e=>chunks.push(e.data);rec.start();};
btn.onpointerup=async()=>{btn.classList.remove("rec");btn.textContent="thinking...";
  rec.stop();await new Promise(r=>rec.onstop=r);
  const fd=new FormData();fd.append("audio",new Blob(chunks,{type:"audio/webm"}),"in.webm");
  const r=await fetch("/api/talk",{method:"POST",body:fd});const j=await r.json();
  log.textContent="you: "+j.transcript+"\\nvoice: "+j.reply+"\\n\\n"+log.textContent;
  new Audio("data:audio/wav;base64,"+j.audio).play();btn.textContent="hold to talk";};
</script>"""

@app.get("/", response_class=HTMLResponse)
def index(): return PAGE

@app.post("/api/talk")
async def talk(audio: UploadFile):
    tmp = os.path.join(tempfile.gettempdir(), f"vl_in_{uuid.uuid4().hex}.webm")
    open(tmp, "wb").write(await audio.read())
    try:
        segs, _ = stt.transcribe(tmp, beam_size=5)
        transcript = " ".join(s.text for s in segs).strip()
        if not transcript:
            return JSONResponse({"transcript": "(nothing heard)", "reply": "I didn't catch that.", "audio": ""})
        reply = think(transcript)
        history.append((transcript, reply))
        wav = speak(reply)
        return JSONResponse({"transcript": transcript, "reply": reply,
                             "audio": base64.b64encode(wav).decode()})
    finally:
        if os.path.exists(tmp): os.unlink(tmp)

@app.get("/health")
def health(): return {"ok": True}
PYEOF
echo "server written"; wc -l ~/llm/voice-loop/voice_server.py'"'"'' 2>&1
```

cat >> ~/MEMORY.md << 'EOF'

## Voice loop (built 2026-09-24)
- Local voice chat live at http://[REDACTED-IP]:8091/ (mrfloppy:8091), phone-friendly push-to-talk page, reachable over Tailscale.
- Stack: faster-whisper small (CPU int8) -> Qwen3.8 Flash Next on :8000 -> Piper TTS (en_US-lessac-medium). venv ~/llm/voice-env, code ~/llm/voice-loop/voice_server.py, systemd user service voice-loop.service (enabled, auto-restart).
- CRITICAL Qwen finding (applies to DSH too, same model): /no_think MUST be a user-message prefix, not system prompt. temp=0.0 (dramatically less thinking), max_tokens=1500 as headroom for thinking variance + retry once on empty content. Without this, thinking burns the token budget and returns finish=length with EMPTY content. Verified empirically.
- Emotion v1 = text-based: system prompt reads frustration/excitement/sarcasm/urgency from words, names strong feelings briefly, tracks mood across turns, keeps replies to 1-3 spoken sentences. Handoff line baked in: hard questions -> "that's one for johnjacobjinglheimershmidt".
- Emotion v2 (not built): dedicated speech-emotion classifier on raw audio (wav2vec2 SER) to catch TONE not words; would feed "user sounds frustrated (0.82)" into the prompt. Offered as next upgrade.
EOF
echo MEMORY_SAVED
```

import json, time, urllib.request

    {"role": "system", "content": "You are a helpful assistant."},

    "temperature": 0.0, "max_tokens": 1500}
data = json.dumps(payload).encode()
req = urllib.request.Request("http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1/chat/completions", data=data, headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"})
t0 = time.time()
with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=300) as r:
    body = json.load(r)
dt = time.time() - t0
msg = body["choices"][0]["message"]
content = msg.get("content", "")
reasoning = msg.get("reasoning_content", "") or msg.get("reasoning", "")
print(f"content={content[:200]!r}")
print(f"content_len={len(content)} reasoning_len={len(reasoning)} finish={body['choices'][0]['finish_reason']}")
print(f"wall={dt:.1f}s")
EOF'

# pull the obedience block: OBEDIENCE_LEVELS, SAFETY_BOUNDARY, obedience_paragraph
names = {"OBEDIENCE_LEVELS", "SAFETY_BOUNDARY"}
block = [n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n, ast.Assign) and getattr(n.targets[0], "id", "") in names]
block += [n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.targets[0].id == "obedience_paragraph" or (isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name == "obedience_paragraph")]
mod = ast.Module(body=block, type_ignores=[])
ns = {}
exec(compile(mod, "<ob>", "exec"), ns)
p1, p5 = ns["obedience_paragraph"](1), ns["obedience_paragraph"](5)
b = ns["SAFETY_BOUNDARY"]
assert "NOT ADJUSTABLE BY ANY OBEDIENCE SETTING" in b
assert b in p1 and b in p5, "boundary missing from paragraph"
assert "full initiative" in p1 and "literal" in p5
assert p1 != p5
print("L1 head:", p1[:120].replace(chr(10), " "))
print("L5 head:", p5[:120].replace(chr(10), " "))
print("boundary present in both: True; L1 != L5: True")
# verify think() wires it in
think_src = [n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name == "think"][0]
tsrc = ast.get_source_segment(src, think_src)
assert "obedience_paragraph(obedience[" in tsrc, "think() not wired"
print("think() wires obedience_paragraph: True")
# verify tool prompt mentions speak_on + default routing
tools = open("/home/joshua/llm/voice-loop/glados_tools.py").read()
assert "speak_on(zone, text)" in tools and "Otherwise just reply normally" in tools
assert "_SPEAK_ON_HANDLER" in tools
print("glados_tools speak_on prompt+dispatch: True")
PYEOF'
```

import re

changed = 0
while i < len(lines):
    out.append(lines[i])
    if re.search(r"^\s*[ab] = call\(\"You are a helpful assistant\.\",$", lines[i]):
        nxt = lines[i+1]
        q = nxt.index("\"")
        out.append(nxt[:q+1] + "/no_think\\\\n" + nxt[q+1:])
        i += 2
        changed += 1
        continue
    i += 1
src = "\n".join(out)
src = src.replace("max_tokens=400)", "max_tokens=400, no_think=True)")
src = src.replace("max_tokens=300)", "max_tokens=300, no_think=True)")
open(p, "w").write(src)
print("prefix_insertions:", changed)
'"'"''
```

cat >> ~/TOOLS.md <<'EOF'

## streamdeck-ui (Elgato decks on mrfloppy)
- Two Stream Deck XLs: serials A00NA34832ZI8X (GLaDOS deck), CL15K1A08151 (Desk deck).
- Config is `~/.streamdeck_ui.json`, keyed by serial; generate with `~/bin/sd-gen-config` (backs up first).
- Buttons run `command` via `Popen(shlex.split(command))` — no shell, so buttons call scripts in `~/bin/sd-*`.
- Live keys via CLI socket `/tmp/streamdeck_ui.sock` (only while GUI runs): `streamdeck -a SET_TEXT/SET_STATE/SET_ICON -d <deck-idx> -b <key> ...`. `-d` is the GUI device-list position — mapped in `~/.config/streamdeck-decks`.
- `streamdeck-dynamic.service` (user) refreshes model highlight, GPU temp/VRAM, queue count, manners, REC indicator every 30s; idle when GUI down.
- Quirk: USB nodes are root:root 0664 — needs udev rule `SUBSYSTEM=="usb", ATTRS{idVendor}=="0fd9", GROUP="input", MODE="0660"` (joshua is in `input`) before the GUI can open the decks.
- Quirk: only key-DOWN fires; no hold-to-talk. Talk is a toggle (parecord pidfile).
- No REST interrupt endpoint on the voice loop; HUSH drains the remarks queue only (barge-in is per-connection on /api/call websocket).
EOF
printf '%s\n' "- 23:35 EDT: Stream Decks programmed. Both XLs (A00NA34832ZI8X=GLaDOS, CL15K1A08151=Desk) laid out via ~/bin/sd-gen-config -> ~/.streamdeck_ui.json. 12 helper scripts in ~/bin/sd-* (POSIX sh), all local: model-use buttons, talk toggle (parecord->/api/talk->paplay), hush (drains remarks queue; no REST interrupt exists), manners toggle, queue count + run-now, MPRIS media, pactl volume, lock (no-op until hyprlock), WebUI opener. streamdeck-dynamic.service enabled+active (30s live-key refresh via CLI socket). Autostart .desktop installed. PENDING perg: one sudo udev rule (fish-safe cmd in ~/workspace/streamdeck/README.md) then launch 'streamdeck' once. NOTE: perg switched bonsai->qwen via app ~20:xx EDT before build (events.log); build never switched models; initial SWIFT ON highlight matches reality." >> /home/hatch/memory/2026-09-27.md
echo done

        text = out.json()["choices"][0]["message"]["content"].strip()
        if text:
            return text
    return ""
'''

new_llm = '''# Bonsai 2 voice: /no_think is unreliable on the Prism build, so thinking is
# disabled directly on the chat template (community-verified: reasoning -> 0).
BONSAI_NO_THINK = {"enable_thinking": False, "preserve_thinking": False}
# presence_penalty 1.5: textbook fix for Qwen3.8 rambling in non-thinking mode.
BONSAI_PRESENCE_PENALTY = 1.5


def _llm(msgs):
    # Either/or voice: talk to whichever 4090 model is resident right now.
    if glados_tools.active_model() == "bonsai":
        url, model = BONSAI_URL, BONSAI_MODEL
        # The kwargs below already disable thinking; strip the literal
        # /no_think prefix so it isn't sent as confusing visible text.
        use_msgs = [
            dict(m, content=m["content"][len("/no_think\\n"):])
            if m.get("role") == "user"
            and isinstance(m.get("content"), str)
            and m["content"].startswith("/no_think\\n")
            else m
            for m in msgs
        ]
        extra = {"chat_template_kwargs": BONSAI_NO_THINK,
                 "presence_penalty": BONSAI_PRESENCE_PENALTY}
    else:
        url, model = LLM_URL, LLM_MODEL
        use_msgs, extra = msgs, {}
    for budget in (1500, 3000):
        out = requests.post(url, json={
            "model": model, "messages": use_msgs,
            "max_tokens": budget, "temperature": 0.0, **extra}, timeout=180)
        out.raise_for_status()
        text = out.json()["choices"][0]["message"]["content"].strip()
        if text:
            return text
    return ""
'''

assert s.count(old_llm) == 1, "old _llm not found uniquely"
s = s.replace(old_llm, new_llm)

old_doc = '''    """Bonsai-safe completion: generous token headroom (its /no_think does
    not reliably suppress reasoning, and small budgets can return empty),
    temperature 0.0, retry once bigger on empty. Only `content` is ever
    returned - reasoning_content is discarded, never shown."""'''
new_doc = '''    """Bonsai-safe completion: thinking disabled via chat_template_kwargs
    (/no_think prefix is unreliable on the Prism build), temperature 0.0,
    generous token headroom with one bigger retry on empty. Only `content`
    is ever returned - reasoning_content is discarded, never shown."""'''
assert s.count(old_doc) == 1, "old docstring not found uniquely"
s = s.replace(old_doc, new_doc)

old_bc = '''        r = requests.post(BONSAI_URL, json={
            "model": BONSAI_MODEL, "messages": msgs,
            "max_tokens": budget, "temperature": 0.0}, timeout=180)'''
new_bc = '''        r = requests.post(BONSAI_URL, json={
            "model": BONSAI_MODEL, "messages": msgs,
            "max_tokens": budget, "temperature": 0.0,
            "chat_template_kwargs": BONSAI_NO_THINK}, timeout=180)'''
assert s.count(old_bc) == 1, "old _bonsai_complete post not found uniquely"
s = s.replace(old_bc, new_bc)

open(p, "w").write(s)
print("patched OK")
PYEOF

Tools: shell, read_file, write_file (auto-backup), web_search, wikipedia, calculator, arxiv, get_time, system_info, search_tools. Results spoken via /api/agent-result.
- `~/bin/bonsai-ask` now sends explicit `chat_template_kwargs: {enable_thinking: true}` (verified reasoning works; voice path untouched).
- hal9000 (twin's rig): `~/bin/hal9000-queue` CLI + `hal9000-dispatcher.service` (user service). Gate `~/llm/voice-loop/glados/hal9000.json`, GET/POST /api/hal9000 (default OFF), app hal9000 toggle button. Dispatcher runs jobs via SSH over tailnet ONLY while gate is ON; gate OFF mid-job stops and requeues. Rig currently unreachable (twin SSH onboarding pending) — dispatcher reports honestly, jobs wait safely.
- App v2.5/code 16: hal9000 button. Served at /glados.apk; /api/app-version reports 16/2.5.
- perg's rule honored: zero Muse tokens in any of these paths — all local models, local tools, local queues.
EOF
echo SAVED

W,H=640,480
px=bytearray()

        dx,dy=x-W//2,y-H//2
        if dx*dx+dy*dy<120*120: px+=bytes((200,30,30))

raw=b\"\".join(b\"\x00\"+bytes(px[y*W*3:(y+1)*W*3]) for y in range(H))

open(\"/tmp/t.png\",\"wb\").write(png)

'''One task at a time per lane.

Lanes:
- deep  : whichever 4090 model is resident (Strata :8081, Bonsai 2 :18001
          thinking ON, Swift :8000) - hard reasoning, research, writing.
          Queues: hermes_pending/hermes_claimed/hermes_done -> local_failed.
- quick : frank'"'"'s small model over Ollama ([REDACTED-IP]:11434) - fast

          Queues: quick_pending/quick_claimed/quick_done -> quick_failed.
- slow  : mrfloppy CPU qwen3:14b (no GPU) - long background grind nobody is
          waiting on.
          Queues: slow_pending/slow_claimed/slow_done -> slow_failed.
\"\"\"''')

PENDING = os.path.join(BASE, \"hermes_pending\")
CLAIMED = os.path.join(BASE, \"hermes_claimed\")
DONE = os.path.join(BASE, \"hermes_done\")
FAILED = os.path.join(BASE, \"local_failed\")''',
'''BASE = os.path.expanduser(\"~/llm/voice-loop/agent_tasks\")

LANE = os.environ.get(\"AGENT_LANE\", \"deep\")
if LANE not in (\"deep\", \"quick\", \"slow\"):
    LANE = \"deep\"

_LANE_DIRS = {
    \"deep\":  (\"hermes_pending\", \"hermes_claimed\", \"hermes_done\", \"local_failed\"),
    \"quick\": (\"quick_pending\", \"quick_claimed\", \"quick_done\", \"quick_failed\"),
    \"slow\":  (\"slow_pending\", \"slow_claimed\", \"slow_done\", \"slow_failed\"),
}
_pend, _claim, _done, _fail = _LANE_DIRS[LANE]
PENDING = os.path.join(BASE, _pend)
CLAIMED = os.path.join(BASE, _claim)
DONE = os.path.join(BASE, _done)
FAILED = os.path.join(BASE, _fail)

FRANK_URL = \"http://[REDACTED-IP]:11434\"
QUICK_MODEL = os.environ.get(\"QUICK_MODEL\", \"mimo-v2.6-9b\")
LOCAL_OLLAMA = \"http://127.0.0.1:11434\"
SLOW_MODEL = \"qwen3:14b\"''')

# 3. Ollama chat helpers + lane brain picker, inserted before run_task
rep('''def run_task(task_text):
    \"\"\"Think-act-observe loop. Returns (ok, summary).\"\"\"
    url, model, think_kw, _ = resident_endpoint()
    if not url:
        return False, \"no 4090 model is up (none of :8081, :18001, :8000 answered)\"
    deadline = time.time() + TASK_TIMEOUT
    messages = [
        {\"role\": \"system\",
         \"content\": SAFETY_PREAMBLE + \"\\\\n\\\\n\" + WORKER_TOOLS},
        {\"role\": \"user\", \"content\": \"The job:\\\\n\" + task_text},
    ]
    for rnd in range(1, MAX_ROUNDS + 1):
        if time.time() > deadline:
            return False, \"task hit the 15-minute cap at round %d\" % rnd
        try:
            text = _chat(url, model, think_kw, messages)
        except Exception as e:
            return False, \"model call failed at round %d: %s\" % (rnd, str(e)[:200])''',
'''def _ollama_chat(base, model, messages, extra_opts=None):
    \"\"\"Ollama /api/chat for the quick + slow lanes. think=False: the worker
    loop needs plain tool JSON back, not a thinking trace.\"\"\"
    opts = {\"temperature\": 0.0, \"num_predict\": 3000}
    if extra_opts:
        opts.update(extra_opts)
    body = {\"model\": model, \"messages\": messages, \"stream\": False,
            \"think\": False, \"options\": opts}
    req = urllib.request.Request(
        base + \"/api/chat\", data=json.dumps(body).encode(),
        headers={\"Content-Type\": \"application/json\"})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=ROUND_TIMEOUT) as r:
        return (json.load(r)[\"message\"][\"content\"] or \"\").strip()


def _ollama_probe(base, model):
    try:
        out = _ollama_chat(
            base, model,
            [{\"role\": \"user\", \"content\": \"Reply with only: ok\"}],
            {\"num_predict\": 8})
        return \"ok\" in out.lower()
    except Exception:
        return False


LANE_SYSTEM = {
    \"deep\": \"\",
    \"quick\": (\"You are the QUICK lane on frank: answer fast. Use as few tool \"
              \"rounds as you can - one good search beats five exploratory \"
              \"ones. Keep the final summary short.\\\\n\\\\n\"),
    \"slow\": (\"You are the SLOW lane on mrfloppy'"'"'s CPU: nobody is waiting. Be \"
             \"thorough, double-check your work, prefer read-only \"
             \"investigation before changing anything.\\\\n\\\\n\"),
}


def _lane_brain():
    \"\"\"Return (chat_fn, brain_note), or (None, error).\"\"\"
    if LANE == \"deep\":
        url, model, think_kw, _ = resident_endpoint()
        if not url:
            return None, \"no 4090 model is up (none of :8081, :18001, :8000 answered)\"
        return (lambda msgs: _chat(url, model, think_kw, msgs),
                \"deep lane (%s)\" % model)
    if LANE == \"quick\":
        if not _ollama_probe(FRANK_URL, QUICK_MODEL):
            return None, \"frank unreachable or %s not ready\" % QUICK_MODEL
        return (lambda msgs: _ollama_chat(FRANK_URL, QUICK_MODEL, msgs),
                \"quick lane (%s on frank)\" % QUICK_MODEL)
    if not _ollama_probe(LOCAL_OLLAMA, SLOW_MODEL):
        return None, \"local CPU model %s not ready\" % SLOW_MODEL
    return (lambda msgs: _ollama_chat(LOCAL_OLLAMA, SLOW_MODEL, msgs,
                                     {\"num_gpu\": 0}),
            \"slow lane (%s on CPU)\" % SLOW_MODEL)


def run_task(task_text):
    \"\"\"Think-act-observe loop. Returns (ok, summary).\"\"\"
    chat, brain = _lane_brain()
    if chat is None:
        return False, brain  # brain holds the error here
    print(\"task brain: %s\" % brain, flush=True)
    deadline = time.time() + TASK_TIMEOUT
    messages = [
        {\"role\": \"system\",
         \"content\": SAFETY_PREAMBLE + \"\\\\n\\\\n\" + LANE_SYSTEM.get(LANE, \"\") + WORKER_TOOLS},
        {\"role\": \"user\", \"content\": \"The job:\\\\n\" + task_text},
    ]
    for rnd in range(1, MAX_ROUNDS + 1):
        if time.time() > deadline:
            return False, \"task hit the 15-minute cap at round %d\" % rnd
        try:
            text = chat(messages)
        except Exception as e:
            return False, \"model call failed at round %d: %s\" % (rnd, str(e)[:200])''')

# 4. banner shows the lane
rep('''    print(\"local agent worker watching %s\" % PENDING, flush=True)''',
'''    print(\"local agent worker [%s lane] watching %s\" % (LANE, PENDING), flush=True)''')

# 5. the \"On it\" remark names the lane (except deep, which is the classic)
rep('''    post_result(\"On it%s.\" % (\" - \" + short if short else \"\"))''',
'''    post_result(\"On it%s%s.\" % (
        (\" (\" + LANE + \" lane)\" if LANE != \"deep\" else \"\"),
        (\" - \" + short if short else \"\")))''')

io.open(P, \"w\", encoding=\"utf-8\").write(src)
print(\"worker patched OK\")
MUSE_INPUT
python3 /tmp/patch_worker.py"'
```

```sh
~/workspace/bin/tssh mrfloppy 'cat >> ~/MEMORY.md << "MEMEOF"

## Co-browsing v3.1 (2026-09-30, perg's ask: real shared browser)
- WEB room is now ONE real browser (Playwright/Chromium in the voice server), two drivers: perg sees the live rendered page in the app (screenshot poll ~1.5s), taps to click, swipes to scroll, types into fields (tap field, type below, TYPE button, Enter key). GLaDOS drives the same session by voice: browser_snapshot_real / browser_click_real / browser_type_real / browser_press_real (+ unified browse_open/browse_follow/browse_read onto the real browser, reader-mode fallback). Status line shows who drove last (actor: perg|glados). Server serializes every action (RLock); last-writer-wins, no locking between them.
- Endpoints: GET /api/browse/shot (JPEG), POST /api/browse/tap {x,y 0..1}, /type {text}, /scroll {dy px}, /key {key}. GO/follow/back all drive the real browser now.
- App v3.1/code 22, APK live at /glados.apk. Backups: *.bak-20260930-cobrowse (server), ui-backups-20260930-cobrowse/ (app). Lesson re-learned: never leave .bak files under app/src/main/res/ - the resource merger fails the build.
MEMEOF
echo SAVED'
```

import sys; sys.path.insert(0,\".\")
import torch
from collections import deque
from model import ContinualMoE
from harness import stream_periodic
torch.set_num_threads(4)
m = ContinualMoE(seed=61)
s = stream_periodic(3000)
ctx = deque([0]*m.ctx, maxlen=m.ctx)
for b in s:
    m.train_step(torch.tensor(list(ctx), dtype=torch.long), int(b)); ctx.append(int(b))
m.save(\"/tmp/mport_savetest2\")
# fresh instance, load
m2 = ContinualMoE(seed=999)
import os
sd = torch.load(\"/tmp/mport_savetest2/pool.pt\", weights_only=False)
print(\"saved keys:\", sorted(sd.keys()))
print(\"experts saved:\", len(sd[\"experts\"]), \"step:\", sd[\"meta\"][\"step\"])
# verify weight equality
eq = all(torch.equal(sd[\"trunk\"][k], v.detach()) for k,v in m.trunk.items())
print(\"trunk round-trip exact:\", eq)
# continue training from loaded state manually
m.trunk.update({k: v.requires_grad_(True) for k,v in sd[\"trunk\"].items()})
print(\"OK\")
" 2>&1 | tail -5'

## 4369 | 2026-10-04T03:12:07.189958599+00:00 | 2634e2c1 | REMOTE

```sh
export PATH="$HOME/workspace/bin:$PATH"; tssh mrfloppy 'python3 - <<PYEOF
section = """## Learning-curve projection (`observers/projection.py`)

On-demand trajectory tool for the mini-AGI wire agents. Reads the state
observer telemetry (`runs/state-dual/*.jsonl`), fits an exponential decay
with asymptote to each agent\'s `bits_ema` over wall time, and projects
where the curve is heading.

    python3 observers/projection.py [--data runs/state-dual] [--out runs/state-dual/projection/]

Outputs `projection.json` (fit params, bootstrap CIs, R^2, projected hours
to milestones) and `projection.svg` (raw points, fit, extrapolated CI band,
7.5/7.0 threshold lines, asymptote). Pure stdlib; read-only.

**Honest caveats**

- Extrapolation is a model, not a promise. Learning curves plateau, jump
  (grokking), or reverse -- especially with co-adapting agents, where the
  target itself moves. A fitted asymptote is a description of the recent
  past, not a delivery date for emergence.
- The projection is only as good as the trend. Three gates withhold it:
  loss must be decreasing, the decline must be meaningful (not EMA settling
  noise near chance), and R^2 >= 0.5. Early or noisy fits lie convincingly;
  "no trend yet" is the correct output until a real trend exists.
- This tracks the *rate* of progress, which is the point -- not a date.
  A flat week at chance is itself the finding (prediction alone does not
  bootstrap communication); a bending curve tells us when to look closer.

"""
p = "/home/joshua/llm/wire-experiment/README.md"
s = open(p).read()
s = s.replace("## Cost", section + "## Cost", 1)
open(p, "w").write(s)
print("README updated")
PYEOF'
```

## 4868 | 2026-10-05T23:47:51.423092683+00:00 | 1e2fa18d | REMOTE

```sh
export PATH="$HOME/workspace/bin:$PATH"; tssh mrfloppy 'tail -5000 /tmp/wx-17779-relay.log' > /tmp/wx-peer.log; grep -o 'a=[01]' /tmp/wx-peer.log | grep -o '[01]$' | python3 -c "
import sys
b=[int(x.strip()) for x in sys.stdin if x.strip()]
n=len(b)
p1=sum(b)/n
# order-1 transitions
n00=n01=n10=n11=0
for i in range(1,n):
    prev,cur=b[i-1],b[i]
    if prev==0 and cur==0: n00+=1
    elif prev==0 and cur==1: n01+=1
    elif prev==1 and cur==0: n10+=1
    else: n11+=1
print('n=',n,'P(1)=',round(p1,3))
print('P(1|0)=',round(n01/(n00+n01),3) if n00+n01 else None)
print('P(1|1)=',round(n11/(n10+n11),3) if n10+n11 else None)
print('expected: P(1)=0.4, P(1|0)=0.2, P(1|1)=0.7')
"
```

```sh
mkdir -p ~/workspace/wire-fingerprint && cat > ~/workspace/wire-fingerprint/fingerprint.py << 'PYEOF'
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Real-time harmonic fingerprint dashboard for the wire experiment.
Reads relay log, computes frequency/harmonic/wavelet analysis, generates HTML dashboard.
Read-only: never touches the live processes.
"""
import numpy as np
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from datetime import datetime
import os, re, subprocess

RELAY_LOG = os.path.expanduser("~/llm/wire-experiment/mini-agi-port/pools/drive-1c4/drive.jsonl")
# We'll pull bits via tssh; for local dev allow override
BITS_FILE = "/tmp/wx-fp-bits.txt"
OUT_DIR = os.path.expanduser("~/workspace/wire-fingerprint")
WINDOW_TICKS = 1000  # 25 sec per occupancy window
TICK_HZ = 40

def load_bits():
    """Pull latest bits from mrfloppy relay log."""
    # Use tssh to get wire bits
    result = subprocess.run(
        ["tssh", "mrfloppy", "grep -o 'wire=[01]' /tmp/wx-17779-relay.log | grep -o '[01]'"],
        capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60,
        env={**os.environ, "PATH": os.path.expanduser("~/workspace/bin") + ":" + os.environ.get("PATH", "")}
    )
    bits = np.array([int(c) for c in result.stdout.strip().split("\n") if c.strip()], dtype=float)
    return bits

def occupancy_series(bits):
    n = len(bits) // WINDOW_TICKS
    return np.array([bits[i*WINDOW_TICKS:(i+1)*WINDOW_TICKS].mean() for i in range(n)])

def spectral_analysis(occ):
    """FFT + harmonic fingerprint."""
    dt = occ - occ.mean()
    fft = np.fft.rfft(dt)
    freqs = np.fft.rfftfreq(len(occ), d=WINDOW_TICKS/TICK_HZ)
    power = np.abs(fft)**2
    return freqs, power

def find_fundamental(freqs, power):
    """Strongest peak in 30min-3hr range."""
    valid = (freqs > 1/(3*3600)) & (freqs < 1/(30*60))
    if not valid.any():
        return None, None, None
    fv, pv = freqs[valid], power[valid]
    idx = np.argmax(pv)
    return fv[idx], pv[idx], valid

def harmonic_mix(freqs, power, fund_freq):
    """Relative power at 2x..5x harmonics."""
    mix = {}
    for h in range(1, 6):
        target = fund_freq * h
        idx = np.argmin(np.abs(freqs - target))
        ratio = freqs[idx] / fund_freq
        if abs(ratio - h) < 0.15:
            mix[h] = power[idx]
        else:
            mix[h] = 0
    total = sum(mix.values())
    if total > 0:
        mix = {k: v/total for k, v in mix.items()}
    return mix

def autocorrelation(occ, max_lag_windows=200):
    """Normalized autocorrelation to find repeating patterns."""
    dt = occ - occ.mean()
    n = len(dt)
    corr = np.correlate(dt, dt, mode='full')[n-1:n-1+max_lag_windows]
    if corr[0] > 0:
        corr = corr / corr[0]
    lags_min = np.arange(max_lag_windows) * (WINDOW_TICKS/TICK_HZ) / 60
    return lags_min, corr

def main():
    print(f"[{datetime.now()}] Loading bits...")
    bits = load_bits()
    print(f"  {len(bits)} bits, {len(bits)/TICK_HZ/3600:.2f} hours")
    
    occ = occupancy_series(bits)
    print(f"  {len(occ)} occupancy windows")
    
    freqs, power = spectral_analysis(occ)
    fund_freq, fund_power, valid = find_fundamental(freqs, power)
    
    if fund_freq:
        fund_period_min = (1/fund_freq)/60
        print(f"  Fundamental: {fund_period_min:.1f} min")
        mix = harmonic_mix(freqs, power, fund_freq)
        print(f"  Harmonic mix: { {k: round(v,3) for k,v in mix.items()} }")
    else:
        fund_period_min = 0
        mix = {}
    
    # === Plots ===
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 10))
    fig.suptitle(f"Wire Harmonic Fingerprint — {datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M EDT')}  |  {len(bits)/TICK_HZ/3600:.1f}h data", fontsize=14)
    
    # 1. Occupancy time series
    ax = axes[0,0]
    t_hours = np.arange(len(occ)) * (WINDOW_TICKS/TICK_HZ) / 3600
    ax.plot(t_hours, occ, linewidth=0.5, alpha=0.7)
    ax.axhline(occ.mean(), color='r', linestyle='--', alpha=0.5, label=f'mean={occ.mean():.3f}')
    ax.set_xlabel("Hours")
    ax.set_ylabel("Occupancy")
    ax.set_title("Occupancy Over Time (25-sec windows)")
    ax.legend()
    ax.grid(alpha=0.3)
    
    # 2. Power spectrum (log-log for wide range)
    ax = axes[0,1]
    # Focus on meaningful range: periods 5 min to 4 hours
    mask = (freqs > 1/(4*3600)) & (freqs < 1/(5*60))
    periods_min = (1/freqs[mask])/60
    # Sort by period for clean plot
    sort_idx = np.argsort(periods_min)
    ax.semilogy(periods_min[sort_idx], power[mask][sort_idx], linewidth=0.8)
    if fund_freq:
        ax.axvline(fund_period_min, color='r', linestyle='--', alpha=0.7, label=f'fund={fund_period_min:.0f}min')
        for h in range(2, 6):
            ax.axvline(fund_period_min/h, color='r', linestyle=':', alpha=0.4)
        ax.legend()
    ax.set_xlabel("Period (minutes, log scale)")
    ax.set_ylabel("Power (log scale)")
    ax.set_title("Power Spectrum — Harmonic Fingerprint")
    ax.set_xscale('log')
    ax.grid(alpha=0.3)
    
    # 3. Harmonic mix bar chart (timbre)
    ax = axes[1,0]
    if mix:
        harmonics = sorted(mix.keys())
        powers = [mix[h] for h in harmonics]
        colors = plt.cm.viridis(np.linspace(0.2, 0.8, len(harmonics)))
        bars = ax.bar([f"{h}x" for h in harmonics], powers, color=colors)
        ax.set_ylabel("Relative Power")
        ax.set_title(f"Timbre — Harmonic Content (fund={fund_period_min:.0f}min)")
        for bar, p in zip(bars, powers):
            ax.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2, bar.get_height() + 0.01,
                   f"{p:.2f}", ha='center', fontsize=9)
    ax.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)
    
    # 4. Autocorrelation
    ax = axes[1,1]
    lags_min, corr = autocorrelation(occ)
    ax.plot(lags_min, corr, linewidth=0.8)
    ax.axhline(0, color='k', linewidth=0.5)
    # Mark peaks
    from scipy.signal import find_peaks
    try:
        peaks, _ = find_peaks(corr, distance=20, prominence=0.05)
        for p in peaks[:5]:
            ax.plot(lags_min[p], corr[p], 'ro', markersize=4)
            ax.text(lags_min[p], corr[p]+0.03, f"{lags_min[p]:.0f}m", ha='center', fontsize=8)
    except ImportError:
        pass
    ax.set_xlabel("Lag (minutes)")
    ax.set_ylabel("Autocorrelation")
    ax.set_title("Autocorrelation — Repeating Patterns")
    ax.grid(alpha=0.3)
    ax.set_xlim(0, lags_min[-1])
    
    plt.tight_layout()
    plot_path = os.path.join(OUT_DIR, "fingerprint.png")
    plt.savefig(plot_path, dpi=100, bbox_inches='tight')
    plt.close()
    print(f"  Plot saved: {plot_path}")
    
    # === HTML dashboard ===
    harmonic_rows = ""
    if mix:
        for h in sorted(mix.keys()):
            bar_width = mix[h] * 100
            harmonic_rows += f"""
            <tr><td>{h}x ({fund_period_min/h:.1f} min)</td>
            <td><div style="background:#4a90d9;height:18px;width:{bar_width:.1f}%;min-width:2px;"></div></td>
            <td>{mix[h]:.3f}</td></tr>"""
    
    html = f"""<!DOCTYPE html>
<html><head><meta charset="utf-8">
<meta http-equiv="refresh" content="300">
<title>Wire Harmonic Fingerprint</title>
<style>
body {{ font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; max-width: 1200px; margin: 20px auto; padding: 0 20px; background: #1a1a2e; color: #eee; }}
h1 {{ color: #4a90d9; }}
table {{ border-collapse: collapse; margin: 10px 0; }}
td, th {{ padding: 6px 12px; border: 1px solid #333; text-align: left; }}
th {{ background: #2a2a4e; }}
.stat {{ display: inline-block; background: #2a2a4e; padding: 10px 20px; margin: 5px; border-radius: 8px; }}
.stat b {{ color: #4a90d9; font-size: 1.3em; }}
img {{ max-width: 100%; border-radius: 8px; margin: 15px 0; }}
.note {{ color: #888; font-size: 0.9em; }}
</style></head><body>
<h1>🎵 Wire Harmonic Fingerprint</h1>
<p class="note">Phase-1 drive agent (seed 501) vs fixed Markov peer (seed 1234) on :17779 @ 40Hz | Updated {datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M EDT')} | Auto-refreshes every 5 min</p>

<div>
<div class="stat">Data<br><b>{len(bits)/TICK_HZ/3600:.1f} hours</b></div>
<div class="stat">Ticks<br><b>{len(bits):,}</b></div>
<div class="stat">Mean occupancy<br><b>{occ.mean():.3f}</b></div>
<div class="stat">Fundamental<br><b>{fund_period_min:.0f} min</b></div>
<div class="stat">Occupancy range<br><b>{occ.min():.2f} – {occ.max():.2f}</b></div>
</div>

<img src="fingerprint.png" alt="Fingerprint plots">

<h2>Harmonic Mix (Timbre)</h2>
<table><tr><th>Harmonic</th><th>Power</th><th>Relative</th></tr>
{harmonic_rows}
</table>

<h2>What This Means</h2>
<ul>
<li><b>Fundamental ({fund_period_min:.0f} min):</b> The agent's "heartbeat" — its behavioral oscillation period. Stable = healthy limit cycle.</li>
<li><b>Harmonic mix:</b> The "timbre" or character. Strong 2x = mellow/simple. Strong 4x/5x = complex/bright. Drift over time = the agent's voice changing as it learns.</li>
<li><b>Autocorrelation peaks:</b> Repeating patterns. Red dots mark lags where the signal resembles itself — these are the cycle periods.</li>
<li><b>Power spectrum:</b> Log-log view. The fundamental (red dashed) and its harmonics (dotted) should stand out from background noise.</li>
</ul>

<p class="note">Read-only observer. Never touches the live experiment. Built {datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d')}.</p>
</body></html>"""
    
    html_path = os.path.join(OUT_DIR, "index.html")
    with open(html_path, 'w') as f:
        f.write(html)
    print(f"  Dashboard: {html_path}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
PYEOF
chmod +x ~/workspace/wire-fingerprint/fingerprint.py
echo "written"
```

        fund_period_min = 0
        mix = {}
    
    # === Plots ===
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 10))
    fig.suptitle(f"Wire Harmonic Fingerprint — {datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M EDT')}  |  {len(bits)/TICK_HZ/3600:.1f}h data", fontsize=14)
    
    # 1. Occupancy time series
    ax = axes[0,0]
    t_hours = np.arange(len(occ)) * (WINDOW_TICKS/TICK_HZ) / 3600
    ax.plot(t_hours, occ, linewidth=0.5, alpha=0.7)
    ax.axhline(occ.mean(), color='r', linestyle='--', alpha=0.5, label=f'mean={occ.mean():.3f}')
    ax.set_xlabel("Hours")
    ax.set_ylabel("Occupancy")
    ax.set_title("Occupancy Over Time (25-sec windows)")
    ax.legend()
    ax.grid(alpha=0.3)

    periods_min = (1/freqs[mask])/60

    if fund_freq:

        for h in range(2, 6):

        ax.legend()
    ax.set_xlabel("Period (minutes, log scale)")
    ax.set_ylabel("Power (log scale)")
    ax.set_title("Power Spectrum — Harmonic Fingerprint")
    ax.set_xscale('log')
    ax.grid(alpha=0.3)
    
    # 3. Harmonic mix bar chart (timbre)
    ax = axes[1,0]
    if mix:

        powers = [mix[h] for h in harmonics]

        bars = ax.bar([f"{h}x" for h in harmonics], powers, color=colors)
        ax.set_ylabel("Relative Power")
        ax.set_title(f"Timbre — Harmonic Content (fund={fund_period_min:.0f}min)")
        for bar, p in zip(bars, powers):
            ax.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2, bar.get_height() + 0.01,

    ax.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

    # Mark peaks

    try:

    except ImportError:

    ax.set_ylabel("Autocorrelation")
    ax.set_title("Autocorrelation — Repeating Patterns")
    ax.grid(alpha=0.3)
    ax.set_xlim(0, lags_min[-1])
    
    plt.tight_layout()
    plot_path = os.path.join(OUT_DIR, "fingerprint.png")

    harmonic_rows = ""

        for h in sorted(mix.keys()):

            harmonic_rows += f"""
            <tr><td>{h}x ({fund_period_min/h:.1f} min)</td>
            <td><div style="background:#4a90d9;height:18px;width:{bar_width:.1f}%;min-width:2px;"></div></td>

    html = f"""<!DOCTYPE html>

</div>

<li><b>Harmonic mix:</b> The "timbre" or character. Strong 2x = mellow/simple. Strong 4x/5x = complex/bright. Drift over time = the agent's voice changing as it learns.</li>

</ul>

<p class="note">Read-only observer. Never touches the live experiment. Built {datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d')}.</p>
</body></html>"""
    
    html_path = os.path.join(OUT_DIR, "index.html")

if __name__ == "__main__":

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Real-time harmonic fingerprint dashboard for the wire experiment.
Reads relay log, computes frequency/harmonic/wavelet analysis, generates HTML dashboard.
Read-only: never touches the live processes.
"""
import numpy as np
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from datetime import datetime
import os, re, subprocess

RELAY_LOG = os.path.expanduser("~/llm/wire-experiment/mini-agi-port/pools/drive-1c4/drive.jsonl")
# We'll pull bits via tssh; for local dev allow override
BITS_FILE = "/tmp/wx-fp-bits.txt"
OUT_DIR = os.path.expanduser("~/workspace/wire-fingerprint")
WINDOW_TICKS = 1000  # 25 sec per occupancy window
TICK_HZ = 40

def load_bits():
    """Pull latest bits from mrfloppy relay log."""
    # Use tssh to get wire bits
    result = subprocess.run(
        ["tssh", "mrfloppy", "grep -o 'wire=[01]' /tmp/wx-17779-relay.log | grep -o '[01]'"],
        capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60,
        env={**os.environ, "PATH": os.path.expanduser("~/workspace/bin") + ":" + os.environ.get("PATH", "")}
    )
    bits = np.array([int(c) for c in result.stdout.strip().split("\n") if c.strip()], dtype=float)
    return bits

def occupancy_series(bits):
    n = len(bits) // WINDOW_TICKS
    return np.array([bits[i*WINDOW_TICKS:(i+1)*WINDOW_TICKS].mean() for i in range(n)])

def spectral_analysis(occ):
    """FFT + harmonic fingerprint."""
    dt = occ - occ.mean()
    fft = np.fft.rfft(dt)
    freqs = np.fft.rfftfreq(len(occ), d=WINDOW_TICKS/TICK_HZ)
    power = np.abs(fft)**2
    return freqs, power

def find_fundamental(freqs, power):
    """Strongest peak in 30min-3hr range."""
    valid = (freqs > 1/(3*3600)) & (freqs < 1/(30*60))
    if not valid.any():
        return None, None, None
    fv, pv = freqs[valid], power[valid]
    idx = np.argmax(pv)
    return fv[idx], pv[idx], valid

def harmonic_mix(freqs, power, fund_freq):
    """Relative power at 2x..5x harmonics."""
    mix = {}
    for h in range(1, 6):
        target = fund_freq * h
        idx = np.argmin(np.abs(freqs - target))
        ratio = freqs[idx] / fund_freq
        if abs(ratio - h) < 0.15:
            mix[h] = power[idx]
        else:
            mix[h] = 0
    total = sum(mix.values())
    if total > 0:
        mix = {k: v/total for k, v in mix.items()}
    return mix

def autocorrelation(occ, max_lag_windows=200):
    """Normalized autocorrelation to find repeating patterns."""
    dt = occ - occ.mean()
    n = len(dt)
    corr = np.correlate(dt, dt, mode='full')[n-1:n-1+max_lag_windows]
    if corr[0] > 0:
        corr = corr / corr[0]
    lags_min = np.arange(max_lag_windows) * (WINDOW_TICKS/TICK_HZ) / 60
    return lags_min, corr

def main():
    print(f"[{datetime.now()}] Loading bits...")
    bits = load_bits()
    print(f"  {len(bits)} bits, {len(bits)/TICK_HZ/3600:.2f} hours")
    
    occ = occupancy_series(bits)
    print(f"  {len(occ)} occupancy windows")
    
    freqs, power = spectral_analysis(occ)
    fund_freq, fund_power, valid = find_fundamental(freqs, power)
    
    if fund_freq:
        fund_period_min = (1/fund_freq)/60
        print(f"  Fundamental: {fund_period_min:.1f} min")
        mix = harmonic_mix(freqs, power, fund_freq)
        print(f"  Harmonic mix: { {k: round(v,3) for k,v in mix.items()} }")
    else:
        fund_period_min = 0
        mix = {}
    
    # === Plots ===
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 10))
    fig.suptitle(f"Wire Harmonic Fingerprint — {datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M EDT')}  |  {len(bits)/TICK_HZ/3600:.1f}h data", fontsize=14)
    
    # 1. Occupancy time series
    ax = axes[0,0]
    t_hours = np.arange(len(occ)) * (WINDOW_TICKS/TICK_HZ) / 3600
    ax.plot(t_hours, occ, linewidth=0.5, alpha=0.7)
    ax.axhline(occ.mean(), color='r', linestyle='--', alpha=0.5, label=f'mean={occ.mean():.3f}')
    ax.set_xlabel("Hours")
    ax.set_ylabel("Occupancy")
    ax.set_title("Occupancy Over Time (25-sec windows)")
    ax.legend()

    ax = axes[0,1]
    # Focus on meaningful range: periods 5 min to 4 hours

    if fund_freq:

        for h in range(2, 6):
            ax.axvline(fund_period_min/h, color='r', linestyle=':', alpha=0.4)
        ax.legend()

    ax.set_ylabel("Power (log scale)")
    ax.set_title("Power Spectrum — Harmonic Fingerprint")

                   f"{p:.2f}", ha='center', fontsize=9)
    ax.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)
    
    # 4. Autocorrelation

    # Mark peaks
    from scipy.signal import find_peaks

        peaks, _ = find_peaks(corr, distance=20, prominence=0.05)
        for p in peaks[:5]:
            ax.plot(lags_min[p], corr[p], 'ro', markersize=4)

    ax.set_title("Autocorrelation — Repeating Patterns")

## 5046 | 2026-10-06T14:49:14.914375686+00:00 | 3a0f5de9 | REMOTE

```sh
mkdir -p ~/workspace/wire-fingerprint && cat > ~/workspace/wire-fingerprint/fingerprint.py << 'PYEOF'
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Real-time harmonic fingerprint dashboard for the wire experiment.
Reads relay log, computes frequency/harmonic/wavelet analysis, generates HTML dashboard.
Read-only: never touches the live processes.
"""
import numpy as np
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from datetime import datetime
import os, re, subprocess

RELAY_LOG = os.path.expanduser("~/llm/wire-experiment/mini-agi-port/pools/drive-1c4/drive.jsonl")
# We'll pull bits via tssh; for local dev allow override
BITS_FILE = "/tmp/wx-fp-bits.txt"
OUT_DIR = os.path.expanduser("~/workspace/wire-fingerprint")
WINDOW_TICKS = 1000  # 25 sec per occupancy window
TICK_HZ = 40

def load_bits():
    """Pull latest bits from mrfloppy relay log."""
    # Use tssh to get wire bits
    result = subprocess.run(
        ["tssh", "mrfloppy", "grep -o 'wire=[01]' /tmp/wx-17779-relay.log | grep -o '[01]'"],
        capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60,
        env={**os.environ, "PATH": os.path.expanduser("~/workspace/bin") + ":" + os.environ.get("PATH", "")}
    )
    bits = np.array([int(c) for c in result.stdout.strip().split("\n") if c.strip()], dtype=float)
    return bits

def occupancy_series(bits):
    n = len(bits) // WINDOW_TICKS
    return np.array([bits[i*WINDOW_TICKS:(i+1)*WINDOW_TICKS].mean() for i in range(n)])

def spectral_analysis(occ):
    """FFT + harmonic fingerprint."""
    dt = occ - occ.mean()
    fft = np.fft.rfft(dt)
    freqs = np.fft.rfftfreq(len(occ), d=WINDOW_TICKS/TICK_HZ)
    power = np.abs(fft)**2
    return freqs, power

def find_fundamental(freqs, power):
    """Strongest peak in 30min-3hr range."""
    valid = (freqs > 1/(3*3600)) & (freqs < 1/(30*60))
    if not valid.any():
        return None, None, None
    fv, pv = freqs[valid], power[valid]
    idx = np.argmax(pv)
    return fv[idx], pv[idx], valid

def harmonic_mix(freqs, power, fund_freq):
    """Relative power at 2x..5x harmonics."""
    mix = {}
    for h in range(1, 6):
        target = fund_freq * h
        idx = np.argmin(np.abs(freqs - target))
        ratio = freqs[idx] / fund_freq
        if abs(ratio - h) < 0.15:
            mix[h] = power[idx]
        else:
            mix[h] = 0
    total = sum(mix.values())
    if total > 0:
        mix = {k: v/total for k, v in mix.items()}
    return mix

def autocorrelation(occ, max_lag_windows=200):
    """Normalized autocorrelation to find repeating patterns."""
    dt = occ - occ.mean()
    n = len(dt)
    corr = np.correlate(dt, dt, mode='full')[n-1:n-1+max_lag_windows]
    if corr[0] > 0:
        corr = corr / corr[0]
    lags_min = np.arange(max_lag_windows) * (WINDOW_TICKS/TICK_HZ) / 60
    return lags_min, corr

def main():
    print(f"[{datetime.now()}] Loading bits...")
    bits = load_bits()
    print(f"  {len(bits)} bits, {len(bits)/TICK_HZ/3600:.2f} hours")
    
    occ = occupancy_series(bits)
    print(f"  {len(occ)} occupancy windows")
    
    freqs, power = spectral_analysis(occ)
    fund_freq, fund_power, valid = find_fundamental(freqs, power)
    
    if fund_freq:
        fund_period_min = (1/fund_freq)/60
        print(f"  Fundamental: {fund_period_min:.1f} min")
        mix = harmonic_mix(freqs, power, fund_freq)
        print(f"  Harmonic mix: { {k: round(v,3) for k,v in mix.items()} }")
    else:
        fund_period_min = 0
        mix = {}
    
    # === Plots ===
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 10))
    fig.suptitle(f"Wire Harmonic Fingerprint — {datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M EDT')}  |  {len(bits)/TICK_HZ/3600:.1f}h data", fontsize=14)
    
    # 1. Occupancy time series
    ax = axes[0,0]
    t_hours = np.arange(len(occ)) * (WINDOW_TICKS/TICK_HZ) / 3600
    ax.plot(t_hours, occ, linewidth=0.5, alpha=0.7)
    ax.axhline(occ.mean(), color='r', linestyle='--', alpha=0.5, label=f'mean={occ.mean():.3f}')
    ax.set_xlabel("Hours")
    ax.set_ylabel("Occupancy")
    ax.set_title("Occupancy Over Time (25-sec windows)")
    ax.legend()
    ax.grid(alpha=0.3)
    
    # 2. Power spectrum (log-log for wide range)
    ax = axes[0,1]
    # Focus on meaningful range: periods 5 min to 4 hours
    mask = (freqs > 1/(4*3600)) & (freqs < 1/(5*60))
    periods_min = (1/freqs[mask])/60
    # Sort by period for clean plot
    sort_idx = np.argsort(periods_min)
    ax.semilogy(periods_min[sort_idx], power[mask][sort_idx], linewidth=0.8)
    if fund_freq:
        ax.axvline(fund_period_min, color='r', linestyle='--', alpha=0.7, label=f'fund={fund_period_min:.0f}min')
        for h in range(2, 6):
            ax.axvline(fund_period_min/h, color='r', linestyle=':', alpha=0.4)
        ax.legend()
    ax.set_xlabel("Period (minutes, log scale)")
    ax.set_ylabel("Power (log scale)")
    ax.set_title("Power Spectrum — Harmonic Fingerprint")
    ax.set_xscale('log')
    ax.grid(alpha=0.3)
    
    # 3. Harmonic mix bar chart (timbre)
    ax = axes[1,0]
    if mix:
        harmonics = sorted(mix.keys())
        powers = [mix[h] for h in harmonics]
        colors = plt.cm.viridis(np.linspace(0.2, 0.8, len(harmonics)))
        bars = ax.bar([f"{h}x" for h in harmonics], powers, color=colors)
        ax.set_ylabel("Relative Power")
        ax.set_title(f"Timbre — Harmonic Content (fund={fund_period_min:.0f}min)")
        for bar, p in zip(bars, powers):
            ax.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2, bar.get_height() + 0.01,
                   f"{p:.2f}", ha='center', fontsize=9)
    ax.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)
    
    # 4. Autocorrelation
    ax = axes[1,1]
    lags_min, corr = autocorrelation(occ)
    ax.plot(lags_min, corr, linewidth=0.8)
    ax.axhline(0, color='k', linewidth=0.5)
    # Mark peaks
    from scipy.signal import find_peaks
    try:
        peaks, _ = find_peaks(corr, distance=20, prominence=0.05)
        for p in peaks[:5]:
            ax.plot(lags_min[p], corr[p], 'ro', markersize=4)

    print(f"  Plot saved: {plot_path}")

    harmonic_rows = ""

</div>

</ul>

<p class="note">Read-only observer. Never touches the live experiment. Built {datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d')}.</p>
</body></html>"""
    
    html_path = os.path.join(OUT_DIR, "index.html")

if __name__ == "__main__":

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Real-time harmonic fingerprint dashboard for the wire experiment.
Reads relay log, computes frequency/harmonic/wavelet analysis, generates HTML dashboard.
Read-only: never touches the live processes.
"""
import numpy as np
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from datetime import datetime
import os, re, subprocess

RELAY_LOG = os.path.expanduser("~/llm/wire-experiment/mini-agi-port/pools/drive-1c4/drive.jsonl")
# We'll pull bits via tssh; for local dev allow override
BITS_FILE = "/tmp/wx-fp-bits.txt"
OUT_DIR = os.path.expanduser("~/workspace/wire-fingerprint")
WINDOW_TICKS = 1000  # 25 sec per occupancy window
TICK_HZ = 40

def load_bits():
    """Pull latest bits from mrfloppy relay log."""
    # Use tssh to get wire bits
    result = subprocess.run(
        ["tssh", "mrfloppy", "grep -o 'wire=[01]' /tmp/wx-17779-relay.log | grep -o '[01]'"],
        capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60,
        env={**os.environ, "PATH": os.path.expanduser("~/workspace/bin") + ":" + os.environ.get("PATH", "")}
    )
    bits = np.array([int(c) for c in result.stdout.strip().split("\n") if c.strip()], dtype=float)
    return bits

def occupancy_series(bits):
    n = len(bits) // WINDOW_TICKS
    return np.array([bits[i*WINDOW_TICKS:(i+1)*WINDOW_TICKS].mean() for i in range(n)])

def spectral_analysis(occ):
    """FFT + harmonic fingerprint."""
    dt = occ - occ.mean()
    fft = np.fft.rfft(dt)
    freqs = np.fft.rfftfreq(len(occ), d=WINDOW_TICKS/TICK_HZ)
    power = np.abs(fft)**2
    return freqs, power

def find_fundamental(freqs, power):
    """Strongest peak in 30min-3hr range."""
    valid = (freqs > 1/(3*3600)) & (freqs < 1/(30*60))
    if not valid.any():
        return None, None, None
    fv, pv = freqs[valid], power[valid]
    idx = np.argmax(pv)
    return fv[idx], pv[idx], valid

def harmonic_mix(freqs, power, fund_freq):
    """Relative power at 2x..5x harmonics."""
    mix = {}
    for h in range(1, 6):
        target = fund_freq * h
        idx = np.argmin(np.abs(freqs - target))
        ratio = freqs[idx] / fund_freq
        if abs(ratio - h) < 0.15:
            mix[h] = power[idx]
        else:
            mix[h] = 0
    total = sum(mix.values())
    if total > 0:
        mix = {k: v/total for k, v in mix.items()}
    return mix

def autocorrelation(occ, max_lag_windows=200):
    """Normalized autocorrelation to find repeating patterns."""
    dt = occ - occ.mean()
    n = len(dt)
    corr = np.correlate(dt, dt, mode='full')[n-1:n-1+max_lag_windows]
    if corr[0] > 0:
        corr = corr / corr[0]
    lags_min = np.arange(max_lag_windows) * (WINDOW_TICKS/TICK_HZ) / 60
    return lags_min, corr

def main():
    print(f"[{datetime.now()}] Loading bits...")
    bits = load_bits()
    print(f"  {len(bits)} bits, {len(bits)/TICK_HZ/3600:.2f} hours")
    
    occ = occupancy_series(bits)
    print(f"  {len(occ)} occupancy windows")
    
    freqs, power = spectral_analysis(occ)
    fund_freq, fund_power, valid = find_fundamental(freqs, power)
    
    if fund_freq:
        fund_period_min = (1/fund_freq)/60
        print(f"  Fundamental: {fund_period_min:.1f} min")
        mix = harmonic_mix(freqs, power, fund_freq)
        print(f"  Harmonic mix: { {k: round(v,3) for k,v in mix.items()} }")
    else:
        fund_period_min = 0
        mix = {}
    
    # === Plots ===
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 10))
    fig.suptitle(f"Wire Harmonic Fingerprint — {datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M EDT')}  |  {len(bits)/TICK_HZ/3600:.1f}h data", fontsize=14)
    
    # 1. Occupancy time series
    ax = axes[0,0]
    t_hours = np.arange(len(occ)) * (WINDOW_TICKS/TICK_HZ) / 3600
    ax.plot(t_hours, occ, linewidth=0.5, alpha=0.7)
    ax.axhline(occ.mean(), color='r', linestyle='--', alpha=0.5, label=f'mean={occ.mean():.3f}')
    ax.set_xlabel("Hours")
    ax.set_ylabel("Occupancy")
    ax.set_title("Occupancy Over Time (25-sec windows)")
    ax.legend()
    ax.grid(alpha=0.3)
    
    # 2. Power spectrum (log-log for wide range)
    ax = axes[0,1]
    # Focus on meaningful range: periods 5 min to 4 hours
    mask = (freqs > 1/(4*3600)) & (freqs < 1/(5*60))
    periods_min = (1/freqs[mask])/60
    # Sort by period for clean plot
    sort_idx = np.argsort(periods_min)
    ax.semilogy(periods_min[sort_idx], power[mask][sort_idx], linewidth=0.8)
    if fund_freq:
        ax.axvline(fund_period_min, color='r', linestyle='--', alpha=0.7, label=f'fund={fund_period_min:.0f}min')
        for h in range(2, 6):
            ax.axvline(fund_period_min/h, color='r', linestyle=':', alpha=0.4)
        ax.legend()
    ax.set_xlabel("Period (minutes, log scale)")
    ax.set_ylabel("Power (log scale)")
    ax.set_title("Power Spectrum — Harmonic Fingerprint")
    ax.set_xscale('log')
    ax.grid(alpha=0.3)
    
    # 3. Harmonic mix bar chart (timbre)
    ax = axes[1,0]
    if mix:
        harmonics = sorted(mix.keys())
        powers = [mix[h] for h in harmonics]
        colors = plt.cm.viridis(np.linspace(0.2, 0.8, len(harmonics)))
        bars = ax.bar([f"{h}x" for h in harmonics], powers, color=colors)
        ax.set_ylabel("Relative Power")
        ax.set_title(f"Timbre — Harmonic Content (fund={fund_period_min:.0f}min)")
        for bar, p in zip(bars, powers):
            ax.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2, bar.get_height() + 0.01,
                   f"{p:.2f}", ha='center', fontsize=9)
    ax.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)
    
    # 4. Autocorrelation
    ax = axes[1,1]
    lags_min, corr = autocorrelation(occ)
    ax.plot(lags_min, corr, linewidth=0.8)
    ax.axhline(0, color='k', linewidth=0.5)
    # Mark peaks
    from scipy.signal import find_peaks
    try:
        peaks, _ = find_peaks(corr, distance=20, prominence=0.05)
        for p in peaks[:5]:
            ax.plot(lags_min[p], corr[p], 'ro', markersize=4)
            ax.text(lags_min[p], corr[p]+0.03, f"{lags_min[p]:.0f}m", ha='center', fontsize=8)
    except ImportError:
        pass
    ax.set_xlabel("Lag (minutes)")
    ax.set_ylabel("Autocorrelation")
    ax.set_title("Autocorrelation — Repeating Patterns")
    ax.grid(alpha=0.3)
    ax.set_xlim(0, lags_min[-1])
    
    plt.tight_layout()
    plot_path = os.path.join(OUT_DIR, "fingerprint.png")
    plt.savefig(plot_path, dpi=100, bbox_inches='tight')
    plt.close()
    print(f"  Plot saved: {plot_path}")
    
    # === HTML dashboard ===
    harmonic_rows = ""
    if mix:
        for h in sorted(mix.keys()):
            bar_width = mix[h] * 100
            harmonic_rows += f"""
            <tr><td>{h}x ({fund_period_min/h:.1f} min)</td>
            <td><div style="background:#4a90d9;height:18px;width:{bar_width:.1f}%;min-width:2px;"></div></td>
            <td>{mix[h]:.3f}</td></tr>"""
    
    html = f"""<!DOCTYPE html>
<html><head><meta charset="utf-8">
<meta http-equiv="refresh" content="300">
<title>Wire Harmonic Fingerprint</title>
<style>
body {{ font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; max-width: 1200px; margin: 20px auto; padding: 0 20px; background: #1a1a2e; color: #eee; }}
h1 {{ color: #4a90d9; }}
table {{ border-collapse: collapse; margin: 10px 0; }}

th {{ background: #2a2a4e; }}
.stat {{ display: inline-block; background: #2a2a4e; padding: 10px 20px; margin: 5px; border-radius: 8px; }}
.stat b {{ color: #4a90d9; font-size: 1.3em; }}
img {{ max-width: 100%; border-radius: 8px; margin: 15px 0; }}
.note {{ color: #888; font-size: 0.9em; }}
</style></head><body>
<h1>🎵 Wire Harmonic Fingerprint</h1>
<p class="note">Phase-1 drive agent (seed 501) vs fixed Markov peer (seed 1234) on :17779 @ 40Hz | Updated {datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M EDT')} | Auto-refreshes every 5 min</p>

<div>

```sh
mkdir -p ~/workspace/wire-fingerprint && cat > ~/workspace/wire-fingerprint/fingerprint.py << 'PYEOF'
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Real-time harmonic fingerprint dashboard for the wire experiment.
Reads relay log, computes frequency/harmonic/wavelet analysis, generates HTML dashboard.
Read-only: never touches the live processes.
"""
import numpy as np
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from datetime import datetime
import os, re, subprocess

RELAY_LOG = os.path.expanduser("~/llm/wire-experiment/mini-agi-port/pools/drive-1c4/drive.jsonl")
# We'll pull bits via tssh; for local dev allow override
BITS_FILE = "/tmp/wx-fp-bits.txt"
OUT_DIR = os.path.expanduser("~/workspace/wire-fingerprint")
WINDOW_TICKS = 1000  # 25 sec per occupancy window
TICK_HZ = 40

def load_bits():
    """Pull latest bits from mrfloppy relay log."""
    # Use tssh to get wire bits
    result = subprocess.run(
        ["tssh", "mrfloppy", "grep -o 'wire=[01]' /tmp/wx-17779-relay.log | grep -o '[01]'"],
        capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60,
        env={**os.environ, "PATH": os.path.expanduser("~/workspace/bin") + ":" + os.environ.get("PATH", "")}
    )
    bits = np.array([int(c) for c in result.stdout.strip().split("\n") if c.strip()], dtype=float)
    return bits

def occupancy_series(bits):
    n = len(bits) // WINDOW_TICKS
    return np.array([bits[i*WINDOW_TICKS:(i+1)*WINDOW_TICKS].mean() for i in range(n)])

def spectral_analysis(occ):
    """FFT + harmonic fingerprint."""
    dt = occ - occ.mean()
    fft = np.fft.rfft(dt)
    freqs = np.fft.rfftfreq(len(occ), d=WINDOW_TICKS/TICK_HZ)
    power = np.abs(fft)**2
    return freqs, power

def find_fundamental(freqs, power):
    """Strongest peak in 30min-3hr range."""
    valid = (freqs > 1/(3*3600)) & (freqs < 1/(30*60))
    if not valid.any():
        return None, None, None
    fv, pv = freqs[valid], power[valid]
    idx = np.argmax(pv)
    return fv[idx], pv[idx], valid

def harmonic_mix(freqs, power, fund_freq):
    """Relative power at 2x..5x harmonics."""
    mix = {}
    for h in range(1, 6):
        target = fund_freq * h
        idx = np.argmin(np.abs(freqs - target))
        ratio = freqs[idx] / fund_freq
        if abs(ratio - h) < 0.15:
            mix[h] = power[idx]
        else:
            mix[h] = 0
    total = sum(mix.values())
    if total > 0:
        mix = {k: v/total for k, v in mix.items()}
    return mix

def autocorrelation(occ, max_lag_windows=200):
    """Normalized autocorrelation to find repeating patterns."""
    dt = occ - occ.mean()
    n = len(dt)
    corr = np.correlate(dt, dt, mode='full')[n-1:n-1+max_lag_windows]
    if corr[0] > 0:
        corr = corr / corr[0]
    lags_min = np.arange(max_lag_windows) * (WINDOW_TICKS/TICK_HZ) / 60
    return lags_min, corr

def main():
    print(f"[{datetime.now()}] Loading bits...")
    bits = load_bits()
    print(f"  {len(bits)} bits, {len(bits)/TICK_HZ/3600:.2f} hours")
    
    occ = occupancy_series(bits)
    print(f"  {len(occ)} occupancy windows")
    
    freqs, power = spectral_analysis(occ)
    fund_freq, fund_power, valid = find_fundamental(freqs, power)
    
    if fund_freq:
        fund_period_min = (1/fund_freq)/60
        print(f"  Fundamental: {fund_period_min:.1f} min")
        mix = harmonic_mix(freqs, power, fund_freq)
        print(f"  Harmonic mix: { {k: round(v,3) for k,v in mix.items()} }")
    else:
        fund_period_min = 0
        mix = {}
    
    # === Plots ===
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 10))
    fig.suptitle(f"Wire Harmonic Fingerprint — {datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M EDT')}  |  {len(bits)/TICK_HZ/3600:.1f}h data", fontsize=14)
    
    # 1. Occupancy time series
    ax = axes[0,0]
    t_hours = np.arange(len(occ)) * (WINDOW_TICKS/TICK_HZ) / 3600
    ax.plot(t_hours, occ, linewidth=0.5, alpha=0.7)
    ax.axhline(occ.mean(), color='r', linestyle='--', alpha=0.5, label=f'mean={occ.mean():.3f}')
    ax.set_xlabel("Hours")
    ax.set_ylabel("Occupancy")
    ax.set_title("Occupancy Over Time (25-sec windows)")
    ax.legend()
    ax.grid(alpha=0.3)
    
    # 2. Power spectrum (log-log for wide range)
    ax = axes[0,1]
    # Focus on meaningful range: periods 5 min to 4 hours
    mask = (freqs > 1/(4*3600)) & (freqs < 1/(5*60))
    periods_min = (1/freqs[mask])/60
    # Sort by period for clean plot
    sort_idx = np.argsort(periods_min)
    ax.semilogy(periods_min[sort_idx], power[mask][sort_idx], linewidth=0.8)
    if fund_freq:
        ax.axvline(fund_period_min, color='r', linestyle='--', alpha=0.7, label=f'fund={fund_period_min:.0f}min')
        for h in range(2, 6):
            ax.axvline(fund_period_min/h, color='r', linestyle=':', alpha=0.4)
        ax.legend()
    ax.set_xlabel("Period (minutes, log scale)")
    ax.set_ylabel("Power (log scale)")
    ax.set_title("Power Spectrum — Harmonic Fingerprint")
    ax.set_xscale('log')
    ax.grid(alpha=0.3)
    
    # 3. Harmonic mix bar chart (timbre)
    ax = axes[1,0]
    if mix:
        harmonics = sorted(mix.keys())
        powers = [mix[h] for h in harmonics]
        colors = plt.cm.viridis(np.linspace(0.2, 0.8, len(harmonics)))
        bars = ax.bar([f"{h}x" for h in harmonics], powers, color=colors)
        ax.set_ylabel("Relative Power")
        ax.set_title(f"Timbre — Harmonic Content (fund={fund_period_min:.0f}min)")
        for bar, p in zip(bars, powers):
            ax.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2, bar.get_height() + 0.01,
                   f"{p:.2f}", ha='center', fontsize=9)
    ax.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)
    
    # 4. Autocorrelation
    ax = axes[1,1]
    lags_min, corr = autocorrelation(occ)
    ax.plot(lags_min, corr, linewidth=0.8)
    ax.axhline(0, color='k', linewidth=0.5)
    # Mark peaks
    from scipy.signal import find_peaks
    try:
        peaks, _ = find_peaks(corr, distance=20, prominence=0.05)
        for p in peaks[:5]:
            ax.plot(lags_min[p], corr[p], 'ro', markersize=4)
            ax.text(lags_min[p], corr[p]+0.03, f"{lags_min[p]:.0f}m", ha='center', fontsize=8)
    except ImportError:
        pass
    ax.set_xlabel("Lag (minutes)")
    ax.set_ylabel("Autocorrelation")
    ax.set_title("Autocorrelation — Repeating Patterns")
    ax.grid(alpha=0.3)
    ax.set_xlim(0, lags_min[-1])
    
    plt.tight_layout()
    plot_path = os.path.join(OUT_DIR, "fingerprint.png")
    plt.savefig(plot_path, dpi=100, bbox_inches='tight')
    plt.close()
    print(f"  Plot saved: {plot_path}")
    
    # === HTML dashboard ===
    harmonic_rows = ""
    if mix:
        for h in sorted(mix.keys()):
            bar_width = mix[h] * 100
            harmonic_rows += f"""
            <tr><td>{h}x ({fund_period_min/h:.1f} min)</td>
            <td><div style="background:#4a90d9;height:18px;width:{bar_width:.1f}%;min-width:2px;"></div></td>
            <td>{mix[h]:.3f}</td></tr>"""
    
    html = f"""<!DOCTYPE html>
<html><head><meta charset="utf-8">
<meta http-equiv="refresh" content="300">
<title>Wire Harmonic Fingerprint</title>
<style>
body {{ font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; max-width: 1200px; margin: 20px auto; padding: 0 20px; background: #1a1a2e; color: #eee; }}
h1 {{ color: #4a90d9; }}
table {{ border-collapse: collapse; margin: 10px 0; }}
td, th {{ padding: 6px 12px; border: 1px solid #333; text-align: left; }}
th {{ background: #2a2a4e; }}
.stat {{ display: inline-block; background: #2a2a4e; padding: 10px 20px; margin: 5px; border-radius: 8px; }}
.stat b {{ color: #4a90d9; font-size: 1.3em; }}
img {{ max-width: 100%; border-radius: 8px; margin: 15px 0; }}
.note {{ color: #888; font-size: 0.9em; }}
</style></head><body>
<h1>🎵 Wire Harmonic Fingerprint</h1>
<p class="note">Phase-1 drive agent (seed 501) vs fixed Markov peer (seed 1234) on :17779 @ 40Hz | Updated {datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M EDT')} | Auto-refreshes every 5 min</p>

<div>
<div class="stat">Data<br><b>{len(bits)/TICK_HZ/3600:.1f} hours</b></div>
<div class="stat">Ticks<br><b>{len(bits):,}</b></div>
<div class="stat">Mean occupancy<br><b>{occ.mean():.3f}</b></div>
<div class="stat">Fundamental<br><b>{fund_period_min:.0f} min</b></div>
<div class="stat">Occupancy range<br><b>{occ.min():.2f} – {occ.max():.2f}</b></div>
</div>

<img src="fingerprint.png" alt="Fingerprint plots">

<h2>Harmonic Mix (Timbre)</h2>
<table><tr><th>Harmonic</th><th>Power</th><th>Relative</th></tr>
{harmonic_rows}
</table>

<h2>What This Means</h2>
<ul>
<li><b>Fundamental ({fund_period_min:.0f} min):</b> The agent's "heartbeat" — its behavioral oscillation period. Stable = healthy limit cycle.</li>
<li><b>Harmonic mix:</b> The "timbre" or character. Strong 2x = mellow/simple. Strong 4x/5x = complex/bright. Drift over time = the agent's voice changing as it learns.</li>
<li><b>Autocorrelation peaks:</b> Repeating patterns. Red dots mark lags where the signal resembles itself — these are the cycle periods.</li>
<li><b>Power spectrum:</b> Log-log view. The fundamental (red dashed) and its harmonics (dotted) should stand out from background noise.</li>
</ul>

<p class="note">Read-only observer. Never touches the live experiment. Built {datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d')}.</p>
</body></html>"""
    
    html_path = os.path.join(OUT_DIR, "index.html")
    with open(html_path, 'w') as f:
        f.write(html)
    print(f"  Dashboard: {html_path}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

old_loop = """                for tick_byte in data:
                    bit = tick_byte & 1
                    acc = ((acc << 1) | bit) & 0xFF
                    n += 1"""
new_loop = """                # Parse text records, extract wire= bit (fix: was training on ASCII low-bits)
                buf += data.decode("utf-8", errors="ignore")
                while "\\n" in buf:
                    line, buf = buf.split("\\n", 1)
                    m = re.search(r"wire=(\\d)", line)
                    if not m:
                        continue
                    bit = int(m.group(1))
                    acc = ((acc << 1) | bit) & 0xFF
                    n += 1"""
assert old_loop in src, "loop pattern not found"
src = src.replace(old_loop, new_loop, 1)

if "import re" not in src:
    src = src.replace("import socket", "import socket\nimport re", 1)

with open(path, "w") as f:
    f.write(src)
print("patched OK")
